summary: ASX 200 +1.40% to a five-month high, tracking Wall St's tech-led rally (Nasdaq +2.13%, oil -5% on US-Iran de-escalation). IT and Health Care led; Utilities the only red sector. MGH +8.06% on a guidance upgrade and CQE +8.63% on FY26 results led gainers; CCP -6.98% on weak FY26 results. Smart Money rotation emphatically domestic-cyclical (Insurance, Leisure, Homebuilding). XJO/XAO/XTO Bullish but XSO still Bearish. RBA holds consensus at 4.35% on 11 August.
